summary.zh: 178份归档哈希一致；昨日九个队列均被通用复核标签替代，今天恢复具名领域议程并留痕。
summary.en: All 178 archived hashes match; yesterday’s nine generic queue labels are replaced with the prior domain-specific agendas, with the regression retained.
